note: depth pass 3: L4 例词补充

words.glossEn: the practice of having one spouse at a time
words.etymology: 希腊 monos「单一」+ gamos「婚姻」
derivation: mono（一）+ gam（婚配）+ -y → 只结一次婚
words.example: Monogamy is the legal norm in most of the country.

words.glossEn: the practice of having more than one spouse
words.etymology: 希腊 polos「多」+ gamos「婚姻」
derivation: poly（多）+ gam（婚配）+ -y → 多配偶
words.example: The novel describes a family shaped by polygamy.

words.glossEn: relating to the stomach
words.etymology: 希腊 gastēr「胃」+ -ic
derivation: gastr（胃）+ -ic → 胃的
words.example: He suffers from gastric pain after large meals.

words.glossEn: the art and science of good eating
words.etymology: 希腊 gastēr「胃」+ nomos「法则」
derivation: gastr（胃）+ o + nomy（法则）→ 关于吃的法则
words.example: The region is famous for its gastronomy.

words.glossEn: a gathered group, especially for worship
words.etymology: 拉丁 congregatio < con-（一起）+ grex（群体）
derivation: con（一起）+ greg（群）+ -ation → 聚成一群
words.example: The congregation stood as the choir began.

words.glossEn: to set apart from a group
words.etymology: 拉丁 segregare < se-（分开）+ grex（群体）
derivation: se（分开）+ greg（群）+ -ate → 使离群
words.example: The old rules segregated passengers by race.

words.glossEn: the lightest noble gas, found in the sun's spectrum
words.etymology: 希腊 hēlios「太阳」+ 化学元素后缀 -ium
derivation: heli（太阳）+ -um（元素名）→ 先在太阳光谱中发现的气体
words.example: The balloon rose quickly once filled with helium.

words.glossEn: a plant that turns toward the sun
words.etymology: 希腊 hēlios「太阳」+ tropos「转向」
derivation: heli（太阳）+ o + trop（转）+ -e → 随太阳转的植物
words.example: A heliotrope grew along the warm wall.

words.glossEn: half of a sphere, especially of the earth
words.etymology: 希腊 hēmi-「半」+ sphaira「球」
derivation: hemi（半）+ sphere（球）→ 半个球
words.example: The southern hemisphere has its summer in December.

words.glossEn: shaped like half a sphere
words.etymology: 希腊 hēmi-「半」+ sphaira「球」+ -ical
derivation: hemi（半）+ sphere（球）+ -ical → 半球形的
words.example: The dome is a hemispherical shell of concrete.

words.glossEn: relating to the liver
words.etymology: 希腊 hēpar/hēpatos「肝」+ -ic
derivation: hepat（肝）+ -ic → 肝的
words.example: The scan revealed impaired hepatic function.

words.glossEn: inflammation of the liver
words.etymology: 希腊 hēpar「肝」+ -itis「炎症」
derivation: hepat（肝）+ -itis（炎症）→ 肝炎
words.example: The vaccine protects against one form of hepatitis.

words.glossEn: a flat shape with six sides
words.etymology: 希腊 hex「六」+ gōnia「角」
derivation: hexa（六）+ gon（角）→ 六个角的图形
words.example: The tiles are shaped like a hexagon.

words.glossEn: a line of verse with six metrical feet
words.etymology: 希腊 hexametros < hex「六」+ metron「尺度」
derivation: hexa（六）+ metr（度量）+ -er → 六个音步
words.example: Homer's epics are written in hexameter.

words.glossEn: a word spelt like another but different in meaning
words.etymology: 希腊 homos「相同」+ graphein「写」
derivation: homo（相同）+ graph（写）→ 写法相同
words.example: The two senses of 'bank' make it a homograph.

words.glossEn: a word that sounds like another but differs in spelling
words.etymology: 希腊 homos「相同」+ phōnē「声音」
derivation: homo（相同）+ phone（声音）→ 读音相同
words.example: 'Sea' and 'see' are homophones.

words.glossEn: having equal dimensions; of equal measure
words.etymology: 希腊 isos「相等」+ metron「尺度」+ -ic
derivation: iso（相等）+ metr（度量）+ -ic → 尺寸相等的
words.example: The drawing uses an isometric projection.

words.glossEn: a form of an element with a different neutron number
words.etymology: 希腊 isos「相同」+ topos「位置」（在周期表同一位置）
derivation: iso（相同）+ top（位置）+ -e → 占同一位置的变体
words.example: Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope of carbon.

words.glossEn: one of four parts of a divided whole
words.etymology: 拉丁 quadrans「四分之一」< quattuor「四」
derivation: quadr（四）+ -ant → 四分之一
words.example: The revenue from that quadrant fell sharply.

words.glossEn: involving the square of an unknown quantity
words.etymology: 拉丁 quadratus「使成方形」< quadrare < quattuor「四」
derivation: quadr（四、方）+ -at- + -ic → 与平方有关的
words.example: Solve the quadratic equation for both roots.
